title: What Your Sun Sign Actually Means
excerpt: Beyond the daily horoscope - the Sun represents your core identity.
body_md:
Your Sun sign is the answer to 'what is your sign?' - but it means far more than a horoscope snippet. The **Sun** represents your core identity: who you are and who you are becoming.

## Why it matters

Each sign gives the Sun a different flavor. Aries Sun expresses through initiative. Taurus Sun expresses through stability.

## What it does not tell you

It does not tell you about your emotions (Moon), relationships (Venus), drive (Mars), or how others see you (Rising). Two people with the same Sun sign can feel completely different.
